description: The three-level set-up of the OF1 case in small: cfd_3d_6dof_net_sheet_collar_amr_onestep (collar, net sheet, four catenary lines, N 40 5) with three refined levels: level 1 a fixed box over the cage (G 16), levels 2 and 3 the cells within two cells of the hull (G 25 2), regrid every 4 steps. The net forces on 60 to 90 small patches, most knots outside each of them; the forces of the nets before their first stage are zero (the patches spread them before level 0 has evaluated the nets).
covers: cfd_amr with three levels around a floating body: G 16 and G 25, regrid with patches freed
net_sheet::ini: lagrange points and forces zero before the first stage
